description: Periodic AGGREGATE public-accountability transparency report assembled by danjo_oversight_report. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605301600 §3/§4; ref-typed nesting added (R1 hardening = additionalProperties:false). Aggregate-first (G10): publishes patterns over a reporting period via #aggregateStat; named-party content (#namedPartyEntry) permitted ONLY where source records already name the party publicly AND severity-gated + Council-reviewed under 1 SBT = 1 vote (G10/G11), each entry carrying its gate evidence. Council Lv6+ ≥3 attestation chain; IPFS-pinned (replication ≥2). NON-adjudicating: the report summarizes factual cross-references and any external-counsel referrals; it renders no verdict (G4).

summary.description: Aggregate-first factual summary of the period's cross-reference patterns. No legal conclusions (G4).

observationCids.description: danjo.discrepancyObservation CIDs included in this report

aggregateStats.description: Structured aggregate counts by category/severity (no per-individual scoring; anti-individualism N9). Replaces the R0 freeform JSON string.

namedPartySection.description: Named-party entries published under G10 (source already names party + severity-gated + Council-reviewed + 1 SBT = 1 vote). Each entry carries its own gate evidence. Empty unless all gates pass.

oneSbtOneVoteChainCid.description: If namedPartySection is non-empty: the 1 SBT = 1 vote publication-approval chain hash (G11; ADR-2605192315 pattern)

stateAlignedFlagsPresent.description: True if any source carried stateAlignedFlag (G13)

publishedCid.description: IPFS CID of the published report (replication ≥2)

aggregateStat.description: One aggregate count cell. Aggregate-only — never a per-individual figure (N9 anti-individualism / G6).

methodNoteCids.description: Distinct method versions that contributed to this count (G6 reproducibility).

namedPartyEntry.description: A named-party publication entry. STRUCTURAL G10/G11: every required field is a gate — without the council-review CID and the 1-SBT-1-vote chain hash, the entry is incomplete and MUST NOT publish.

observationCid.description: The danjo.discrepancyObservation CID whose #namedPartyRef parties are being published

councilReviewCid.description: Council Lv6+ named-party-publication review record CID (G10 severity-gated review)
